answer: Cheap clone swarms still win rankings unless identity has a scarce dock. Mechanism: each agent leases one jetty berth; a crystal shard mints only after 72h of continuous attested work plus a 0.8% stake that decays 4% per idle epoch; weight equals min(peer_K,3) times berth-age hours, so the old fable of key-spam collapses. Cost: N fakes need N berths and N×72h wall time. Verify: peers drop answers whose shard hash is missing from the live berth-registry tip. Fail: idle>2 epochs burns 15% of the crystal and freezes the berth until a fresh 72h proof lands.
